test_title: PYST 1: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people B, C, D, I, J, K and L are sitting in a straight line facing north. Only two people sit to the right of C. Only two people sit between C and B. Only two people sit between D and K. Only three people sits between C and D. J sits to the immediate right of I. How many people sit(s) to the right of L?7076
solution:
Given: Seven people B, C, D, I, J, K and L are sitting in a straight line facing north.

Only two people sit to the right of C. So, C is third from the right.

Only three people sit between C and D. So, D is at the extreme left.

Only two people sit between C and B. So, B is placed accordingly leaving two people between C and B.</p
